name: Archmage Arugal casts from his spot at a player across the lair instead of walking to them
contract: Archmage Arugal (4275) is a caster who stands at his desk and moves only by Shadow Port. His kit casts Wrath of Arugal
(2102677) with the SmartAI flag that allows combat movement when the cast fails. Since #12220 limited Wrath to 30 yards,
a player at the lair door (about 40 yards) made him walk toward the stairs. Wrath keeps the range Spell.dbc gives it
and ignores line of sight again, as Spell.dbc gives it, and Arugal no longer walks in combat.
The test pulls a summoned Arugal next to his spawn; it runs the same SmartAI as his spawn.
The kit rows have no difficulty mask, so the test runs on Normal.

steps.label: CONTROL: p is in a Normal Shadowfang Keep
Join world phase 1, where Shadowfang Keep is spawned
p steps 18 yards west, staying in combat
p steps another 18 yards west, across the lair
CONTROL: p stands inside the lair, more than 30 yards from Arugal
Arugal does not walk toward p
Arugal is still more than 30 yards from p
Wrath of Arugal reaches p across the lair
